product.title: SEABOB Snorkel Reef Tour in Fort Lauderdale

description.text: Experience Fort Lauderdale's nearshore reef with a guided SEABOB and snorkeling tour that combines marine-life viewing with high-energy propulsion in the water. After orientation and equipment setup, follow your guide to reef zones where you can alternate between surface snorkeling and SEABOB-assisted exploration. The experience is designed for confident swimmers who want to cover more water than a traditional snorkel outing while still learning about local reef habitats. This small-group adventure includes core snorkeling gear and safety supervision throughout the session.

highlights: Guided SEABOB and snorkel experience over Fort Lauderdale reef areas
Cover more water than standard snorkeling with motorized in-water propulsion
Small-group format with briefing and safety oversight

start.description: 401 N Birch Rd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304, USA. Please arrive early to check in and complete safety orientation.

itineraryItems.title: Check-In and Equipment Setup
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide, review safety procedures, and get fitted with snorkel equipment and SEABOB controls.

itineraryItems.title: Nearshore Reef Exploration
itineraryItems.description: Enter the water and follow your guide along reef sections while alternating snorkeling and SEABOB travel.

itineraryItems.title: Marine-Life Viewing
itineraryItems.description: Pause in selected reef zones to observe fish and coral habitats with commentary from your guide.

itineraryItems.title: Return to Shore
itineraryItems.description: Complete the guided route and return to the launch area for wrap-up.
